chapter: Central Avenue clubs, Nordskog, Sheffield and Music Town
title: Paul Williams draws the Sunshine label
summary: The California mission and palm trees on the Sunshine label were drawn by the later architect Paul Williams, who wanted to join the record company.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: I don't know. Now this...this picture on here --Sunshine label--was drawn by Paul Williams!
Yeah. He was...he wanted to be in my company-- my record company. You know he was crazy about music and stuff, and he come down there, and he drew that picture for me.
Oh. Was he...he wasn't an architect yet then, was he?
He was? He was already an architect?
Yeah. See it's called Sunshine, and he had the California thing on there, see? Got the mission and the palm trees and ever'thing on there.
That's interesting. I don't ever remember reading that any place...that...
I don't think it was ever known, but he's the one who drew it for me and gave it to us.
